description: Every fix from your Audit's drive, in order: what it is, why, how, its effort and team, the level the fixes up to it reach, its state (open, fixed, as_is or doesnt_apply with your reason) and what the drives found (result done or still_there; new_since for a fix a later drive found). It comes with the Audit's report. Also the Audit's drives (the audit drive and each new drive after fixes, with the level it reached and its report) and redrive (whether one can start now and why not, until when). The list is yours to work through: it never moves your level; a new drive does (followup_drive).
